<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 100 with a clear M+1 peak at ~5.6 % intensity and rapidly decreasing higher isotopic peaks. This pattern matches the natural 13C abundance (≈1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing several carbons, giving an M+1 intensity of about 5 % (≈5 × 1.1 %). No characteristic 2 Da spacing or relative intensities for Cl, Br, S, etc., are present, so only carbon can be identified with confidence.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
